text: Task blocked: Prototype agent was stopped by the founder; relaunch only on founder instruction
unblock: Founder asked for real building; re-queued
Read mechanism spec: M1-M4 with lo/hi/default ranges, M5 off by default, intensity ceiling 0.8, no clock distortion in M3, interaction rule M1->M2 coupling only
Read co-design charter: unskippable debrief with 10 required content points, claims never to be made, hard design rules (pause/stop/skip, reduced sensory option by default, no scores)
Read instruments spec: day-0 measures T0 and T1 (intention 5, self-efficacy 3, knowledge 8, QPS, IRI-PT 7, IOS 1, RIBS, AQ-27 pity/fear, distress 0-10, practice-selection task, toolkit take-up)

Design: one self-contained index.html, no network (CSP connect-src none), screens intro/consent, T0 measures, baseline run, load run, comparison, mandatory debrief, T1 measures + practice selection, JSON export; facilitator drawer tunes M1-M5 within spec ranges, session ceiling 0.8

Task: email read-along (paced phrases), forced wait with smaller-sooner choice (M3), 8 questions with registration delay (M2), reply composer; two matched forms A/B to avoid memory carry-over, optional identical-content mode
Spec conflict noted: task text calls M3 time-blindness, but mechanism spec M3 is delay aversion only and section 6 says time perception is NOT modeled; following the spec

Instruments: validated scale item texts (QPS, IRI-PT, RIBS, OMS-WA, AQ-27, Marlowe-Crowne) are not in the instruments spec, so v0 will not administer them and will list them as not_administered in the export; only named items used
Building index.html in parts (css+shell, content, engine, ui, export) in the scratchpad, then assembling into mvp/index.html
Wrote first full draft of perspective-engine/mvp/index.html (about 1160 lines: css, content, engine M1-M5, measures, debrief, planning, export, self-test)
node --check on the script extracted to a scratch file: syntax OK
Self-test found two issues (word 'superpower' in M5 caveat, generic 'name' keys in events); reworded and renamed keys

Headless Chromium (Playwright) end-to-end run: consent, T0, round 1, round 2, comparison, debrief gate, planning, T1, JSON download all worked; 0 page errors, 0 external requests; found and fixed array-flatten bug in DOM mounting, vignette covering Stop, wrong sender name, past-tense practice wordin
WCAG contrast computed for 24 colour pairs used (text, buttons, banner, notification, inner-voice, focus/border): all pass AA (lowest text 7.65:1, control borders 3.86:1 vs 3:1 needed)
M2 distribution check over 3000 simulated runs: round 1 mean 0.999 s CV 0.28, round 2 mean 1.003 s CV 1.14, worst drift 5.0% (limit 5%), about 1.3 late responses per 9 in round 2 vs 0.03 in round 1

Headless run with M5 enabled: lock-in started at onset, M1/M4 damping events and missed cues logged, no page errors; sound and gentle-motion paths ran without errors; reduced-motion emulation sets body.rm and disables the motion option
